name: revit.create_element
description: Creates a generic element in the active Revit document between two points. Supports MEP elements (ducts, pipes, conduits, cable trays) and other curve-based families by specifying type_name.

start_point.description: Start point [X, Y, Z] in feet

end_point.description: End point [X, Y, Z] in feet

type_name.description: Name of the element type to use (e.g. duct type, pipe type). If omitted, uses the first available MEP curve type.

level_name.description: Name of the level to place the element on. If omitted, uses the lowest level.

system_type_name.description: Exact name of the piping/mechanical system type (e.g. 'Hydronic Supply'). When provided, fails if not found instead of defaulting.

mep_system_classification.description: MEP system classification (e.g. 'Supply Air', 'Sanitary'). Used as fallback when system_type_name is not provided.

mep_system_name.description: Name of the specific MEP system the element belongs to (informational, for replay context).

pipe_type_name.description: Name of the pipe type (informational, recorded during capture).

duct_type_name.description: Name of the duct type (informational, recorded during capture).

examples.description: Create a duct between two points
Create a pipe with a specific diameter
